intended_use: Use as context layer on top of delta analysis
Do not let advisory override measured data
Prefer advisory-based comments when a measured behaviour clearly conflicts with target technique
example_checks: If throttle pickup occurs materially after stated target point, flag as late throttle relative to booklet
If gear channel differs from target gear at corner minimum speed, flag gear mismatch
If brake release is prolonged where booklet asks for quick compression or sharp brake, flag weak rotation setup
If steering scrub remains high on exit where booklet says minimise scrub, flag exit inefficiency
